lessons: Review approved the design: run dict bounded by max_runs, an exclusive gate that waits only on slot-holding runs, waiting_for_merge giving back the slot, and callers moved to occupied(). Redo all of it from the merge base. The only defect is in the release paths in clutch/daemon.py.

In clutch/daemon.py, DaemonAdmission.dispatch's finally must give back the slot without awaiting. Decrement the holding count synchronously and wake waiters synchronously (set Events or futures), or run the release through _protected_cleanup(asyncio.create_task(...)) as the waiting_for_merge

In clutch/daemon.py, exclusive()'s exit must clear the exclusive flag synchronously before any await, never inside `async with self._condition` in a finally. A second cancel of a mutations(), startup or sweep holder must not leave the gate held.

In clutch/serve.py, watch publication releases the gate with `await gate.__aexit__` in a finally. Make that exit impossible to cancel: make exclusive()'s exit synchronous, or wrap the exit so a cancelled watch loop cannot leave the gate set.

Add to tests/unit/test_admission_parallel_run_set.py: (1) cancel a dispatch caller twice while the release is contended, then assert the next dispatch is admitted; (2) cancel an exclusive-gate holder twice during a contended exit, then assert a run and a later gate are both admitted.
